lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: 女神再生の儀式、すでに狙われている。
lines.listener_reaction: Dimitri's attention hardens while Dedue checks the exits.
lines.visible_action: Rhea moves one hand from the crest to the stair rail.
lines.cut_relation: cut after the group receives the threat, before Seteth translates it into logistics.
lines.post_dialogue_action: Rhea holds the students in silence for one breath.

lines.speaker: Seteth
lines.text: 今夜、聖墓の入口を離れるな。
lines.listener_reaction: Byleth accepts the boundary without nodding theatrically.
lines.visible_action: Seteth marks the tomb direction with one controlled gesture.
lines.cut_relation: cut on the students' shared turn toward preparation.
lines.post_dialogue_action: Dimitri shifts half a step behind Byleth, becoming a protective layer.

lines.speaker: Dimitri
lines.text: 先生、私たちはあなたの指示に従います。
lines.listener_reaction: Byleth registers the commitment but does not reward it with a smile.
lines.visible_action: Dimitri turns his torso to make a shield line behind Byleth.
lines.cut_relation: cut on the protective repositioning rather than on a heroic pose.
lines.post_dialogue_action: Dedue opens the path toward the preparation room.

lines.speaker: Byleth
lines.text: 足音を数えろ。光を追うな。
lines.listener_reaction: Dimitri and Dedue lower their gaze to the floor and thresholds.
lines.visible_action: Byleth tightens one strap and signals the first walking mark.
lines.cut_relation: cut on the group beginning the same movement.
lines.post_dialogue_action: The three leave the preparation area in a single controlled pace.

lines.speaker: Dedue
lines.text: 左の壁に、外から触れた跡があります。
lines.listener_reaction: Dimitri turns his head toward the wall without stepping into Dedue's mark.
lines.visible_action: Dedue reveals the scraped dust and then points only with his eyes.
lines.cut_relation: cut on Byleth receiving the warning, not on the hand detail.
lines.post_dialogue_action: Byleth raises one flat hand to stop the group.

lines.speaker: Byleth
lines.text: ここから先は、列を崩さない。
lines.listener_reaction: Dimitri lowers his weapon line and Dedue angles his shield toward the opening.
lines.visible_action: Byleth raises one hand and sets three separate stopping marks.
lines.cut_relation: cut just as the unowned footfall begins, preserving the suspense.
lines.post_dialogue_action: Nobody crosses the inner door before the sound arrives.

lines.speaker: Dimitri
lines.listener_reaction: Byleth turns the sword angle toward the arch while Dedue anchors the rear.
lines.visible_action: The Death Knight enters one step and stops in a pool of practical light.
lines.cut_relation: cut on recognition before the threat advances.
lines.post_dialogue_action: The Death Knight tilts the helmet a fraction toward Byleth.

lines.speaker: DeathKnight
lines.text: 退け。儀式の夜は、まだ終わらぬ。
lines.listener_reaction: Byleth keeps the face unreadable and shifts one foot to the safe side of the column.
lines.visible_action: The Death Knight lowers the scythe into a threatening horizontal line without charging.
lines.cut_relation: cut on the final syllable into the first physical attack beat.
lines.post_dialogue_action: Byleth turns the sword to meet the incoming line.

lines.speaker: Byleth
lines.listener_reaction: Dimitri obeys immediately; Dedue keeps his body between the rear and the open passage.
lines.visible_action: Byleth walks backward while keeping the sword line pointed at the safe gap.
lines.cut_relation: cut on the group clearing the threshold, not on a chase.
lines.post_dialogue_action: The Death Knight does not pursue into the practical light.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: まず、事実だけを報告しなさい。
lines.listener_reaction: Byleth pauses before naming intent; Dimitri looks down at the wet edge of the sheet.
lines.visible_action: Rhea sets the report flat and removes one subjective mark with her finger.
lines.cut_relation: cut to Manuela's observation as the institution opens a second lane.
lines.post_dialogue_action: Byleth's gaze returns to the unseen tomb door.

lines.speaker: Manuela
lines.text: 侵入者は、儀式の中心を知っていたわ。
lines.listener_reaction: Byleth looks from the damp route note to the closed door.
lines.visible_action: Manuela traces the internal path with one finger and stops at the central mark.
lines.cut_relation: cut when the finger stops, before anyone explains the implication.
lines.post_dialogue_action: Hanneman enters the edge of frame carrying an unopened book.

lines.speaker: Hanneman
lines.text: 偶然ではない。誰かが道を開けた。
lines.listener_reaction: Manuela's hand stops; Rhea's expression remains calm but her eyes leave the paper.
lines.visible_action: Hanneman pins the route paper under the book without opening it.
lines.cut_relation: cut on the unlit candle, leaving the implication unresolved.
lines.post_dialogue_action: The camera holds the unused book as a physical secret.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: 信仰を守るため、秘密は必要です。
lines.listener_reaction: Dimitri watches Rhea leave; Dedue looks to Byleth for the next safe movement.
lines.visible_action: Rhea keeps one hand on the stair rail and turns away after the line.
lines.cut_relation: cut on the institutional retreat, before the students choose whether to follow.
lines.post_dialogue_action: Byleth turns the group toward the corridor without looking back.

lines.speaker: Dimitri
lines.text: 私たちは勝ったのに、誰も安心していない。
lines.listener_reaction: Byleth listens without turning the admission into reassurance.
lines.visible_action: Dimitri releases the weapon grip and lowers his eyes to the wet floor.
lines.cut_relation: cut on the unresolved pause into a different red-lit space.
lines.post_dialogue_action: A distant metal resonance answers from outside the cloister.

lines.speaker: Flame Emperor
lines.text: 女神の儀式を、教会だけのものにするな。
lines.listener_reaction: The distant armored presence does not answer; its helmet turns toward the forest edge.
lines.visible_action: Flame Emperor takes one half-step into the practical red side light.
lines.cut_relation: cut on the listener's turn rather than explaining the claim.
lines.post_dialogue_action: Flame Emperor keeps the question open and the center space empty.

lines.speaker: FlameEmperor
lines.text: 死神騎士は、まだ使命を終えていない。
lines.listener_reaction: The armored presence pauses on the slope and does not reveal a face.
lines.visible_action: Flame Emperor remains behind the tree while the other figure takes one measured step.
lines.cut_relation: cut on the step stopping, withholding the identity reveal.
lines.post_dialogue_action: The forest sound continues for one beat after the figures stop.

lines.speaker: Sothis
lines.text: 教会は、何を隠している？
lines.listener_reaction: Byleth looks at the sealed door rather than at Sothis.
lines.visible_action: Sothis gathers as a brief reflection along the column and then loses definition.
lines.cut_relation: cut on the question hanging over Byleth's stopped body.
lines.post_dialogue_action: Byleth does not answer and keeps one hand away from the door.
